question: Can the full previously climate-complete domain obtain external insect references separated from the localities and internal query points used to evaluate historical climate?
taxonomy: strict EXACT SPECIES match, Insecta, canonical name equals requested name, confidence >=95; accepted usage keys retained and alias groups reported
window_rule: complete if count <=900; else offsets 0, floor((min(count,100000)-300)/2), min(count,100000)-300; no claim of representative sampling
separation_rule: nearest original locality OR any of the original five internal great-circle query positions, minus occurrence uncertainty, >= buffer; not continuous-route buffering
claim_limits: descriptive reference support only, no genetic response or climate outcome
absence of sufficient retrieved points is not species absence or proof no external data exist
host observations not rebuilt in this stage
partial/bounded retrieval and API index shifts are explicitly retained
